Definition: to feel of; by implication, to grope
BiblicalUsage: 1) to feel, grope; 1a) (Qal) to feel, grope; 1b) (Piel) to feel over or through, grope; 1b1) to feel through; 1b2) to grope; 1c)(Hiphil) to feel
